sources.entry: Fork Recipes - Manage your food recipes with simplicity. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Docker

summary.one_liner: Fork Recipes is a Django-based Python web frontend for managing food recipe collections, designed to work with the ForkApi backend.
summary.what_it_does: The application is a frontend web app built with Django 5.x that connects to the ForkApi to manage recipe collections. It supports creating video- or image-based recipes, saving favorites, and organizing recipes into categories. Recipes can be printed in compact or extended layouts, and a built-in meal planning scheduler is included. It also offers backup snapshot import, export, and apply for the database. Optional smart kitchen features include a shopping list, recipe scraping from URLs, generating recipes from ingredients, translation, audio narration in English, and emojis in scraped content; these require an OpenAI token.
use_cases: plan weekly meals with a scheduler
print recipes in compact or extended layouts
build a shopping list from recipe ingredients
back up and restore recipe database snapshots
how_to_run: Installation instructions are in the ForkAPI documentation (linked from the README; the link text is 'follow').
notable: Video or image based recipe support
Backup snapshot import, export and apply
Optional OpenAI-powered recipe scraping, generation, translation and narration
caveats: Requires the separate ForkApi backend to function
AI features need an OpenAI token and are optional
Installation details are deferred to the ForkApi documentation rather than this README
